evidence: Official stock-quote docs describe bid, ask, mid, lastPrice and one lastUpdate field and call the quote NBBO.
Official pricing page states the Free plan is $0 but has 15-minute data freshness and only 5 requests/day.

Higher plans advertise lower-latency/live features, but paid fallback is forbidden.
reopen_condition: Free plan changes to same-run RTH realtime NBBO with independent quote/trade event timestamps while remaining permanent-$0 and lawful for the intended automated use.
